operating_notes.text: Mobility segment product sales rose 23.3% in Q4FY26 and 16.9% in FY26; Power Solutions grew 27.4% in Q4 and 17.6% in FY26.
Two-wheeler business grew 63.4% in Q4FY26 and 69.1% in FY26 on higher exhaust gas sensor sales after OBD-II norms from April 1, 2025.
Beyond Mobility product sales fell 9.1% in Q4FY26 and 13.6% in FY26 after the May 2025 sale of the video-solutions business.
Power Solutions achieved ₹130+ Bn TNS in CY25 and ₹14+ Bn in March 2026.
Mobility Aftermarket exports grew about 17%, with improvements in Nepal, Bangladesh and Sri Lanka.
FY26 total Indian vehicle production was 26.86 Mio units, with FY27 guided at 27.92–28.27 Mio.
Inventory levels normalized to 28 days in March 2026 from 52 days in March 2025.
Two-Wheeler segment grew 69.1% in FY26 due to OBD2 exhaust sensor ramp-up.
Power Solutions division surpassed ₹13,000 Cr net sales in CY2025.
Mobility segment revenue from product sales reached ₹17,070 Cr in FY26.
Consumer Goods segment revenue from product sales reached ₹1,840 Cr in FY26.
Mobility aftermarket independent business achieved its highest ever monthly sales in June.
Exports are about 8-8.5% of revenue, with management aiming to increase the share.
Bosch Chassis Systems acquisition completed in July; consolidation begins Q2FY27.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹5,565.7 Cr (+13.3% YoY), net profit ₹570 Cr (+3.0% YoY).

2026-05-20: Investor presentation for the Q4FY26 concall showed FY26 revenue ₹20,035 Cr (+10.8%), PAT ₹2,650 Cr (+37.6%) including the video-solutions sale gain, and FY27 industry production guided at 27.92–28.27 Mio units.
Bosch Limited announced a 50:50 joint venture with Brakes India and Wheels India for commercial vehicle air systems.
Bosch Limited shared the Q4 FY 2025-26 Investors’ Concall recording (21.05.2026) on its website via **V. Srinivasan** (Company Secretary).
Bosch Limited reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹5,566 Cr and announced a new 50:50 JV for advanced CV air systems.
Bosch Limited presented its FY26 performance and FY27 industry outlook at its Annual Investors Meet, highlighting a 10.8% revenue growth and strategic transition toward platform solutions.
Bosch Limited filed an investor presentation for the Citi India Investor Conference 2026, highlighting software-driven mobility trends.
Bosch received in-principle approvals from NSE and BSE for preferential issue of 2,460 equity shares to promoters at a price not less than ₹35,200 per share.
Bosch held its Q1FY27 earnings call on August 11, 2026, reporting 22% YoY revenue growth to ₹5,842 Cr and 14.0% EBITDA margin, with PAT down 37.1% YoY due to an exceptional gain in the base quarter.
